Source Tree

  • CURIE: gmeow:SourceTree
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceTree
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A content-addressed directory tree of source code — the recursive Merkle structure that represents a snapshot of a project's files and subdirectories at a point in time. Aligned to Software Heritage Directory and git tree objects by reference.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:SourceNode

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:SourceTree as a specialized kind of gmeow:SourceNode. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
